summary: Phase 4 now presents frozen content-trigger evidence at the existing guarded commit boundary. A matching implementation lists every settled repository path with its add, delete, modify, or rename relationship and exact signed byte-size change, reconstructed only from the eligible durable settlement and retained implementation output. Later approval-rule edits cannot rewrite that explanation, and any incomplete join fails closed to inspection instead of presenting partial evidence. Non-matching implementations still require the same explicit commit authorization, and every authorized commit still requires a separate human confirmation; autonomous activation remains deferred to Phase 5. Focused, unit, contract, integration, crash, schema, release-integrity, and offline-payload verification passed after rebuilding the tracked repository payload, and both the fresh same-side review and server-owned independent review found no material defects. The full rename endpoint matrix is pinned at the pure production seam; the end-to-end semantic journey covers add, delete, modify, post-settlement config editing, frozen archive/presentation behavior, unchanged choices, and separate confirmation. No machine-global installation occurred.
